# Hygge

> Hygge (pronounced [hoo-gah]) is an iOS app that finds jobs and gigs you like, so you can earn a little extra for the life you want to live. Hygge means being cozy and spending quality time with the people you love.

## About

- Hygge searches job sites for work that matches what you like doing, applies with your approval, and keeps track of bookings. You only get involved when you are booked.
- The app is currently in beta, distributed through TestFlight, and is free until $100 confirmed earnings in a month. The paid plan (Plus) is $9.99/month or $99/year for unlimited earnings.
- Hygge is made by Get BOB, Inc., a Delaware corporation. Contact: support@usehygge.app
